parsed.text: Panel p0 current estimates (copied prior records): at node n0 the red distribution concentrates on the top-left 2x2 block (peaks at [0,0],[0,1],[1,0],[1,1]; peak probability ~0.229) and the blue distribution concentrates on the top-right 2x2 block (peaks at [0,2],[0,3],[1,2],[1,3]; peak probability ~0.199). Nodes n1–n3 current distributions for both roles are uniform over all 16 grid cells. Candidate command records are conditional, not executed events: under command k0 n0’s candidate peaks match the current n0 pattern; under k2 n0’s candidate distributions are much more concentrated to single cells (blue peak at [0,2], red peak at [0,0], with much higher peak probabilities). Other candidate entries (k0, k1, k2 for nodes n1–n3 and k1 for n0) remain uniform. Copied prior records are inherited, not new estimates; command-origin entries are conditional estimates at their represented times.
